```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
library(leaflet)
library(jsonlite)
```
```{r}
raw <- jsonlite::fromJSON("data/wildfires.geojson", simplifyVector = FALSE)
length(raw$features)
```
```{r}
fires <- tibble(features = raw$features) |>
  unnest_wider(features) |>
  unnest_wider(properties) |>
  unnest_wider(geometry, names_sep = "_") |>
  select(incident, gis_acres, fire_year, agency, state, geometry_coordinates) |>
  mutate(
    gis_acres = as.numeric(gis_acres),
    fire_year = as.integer(fire_year)
  )

fires
```

```{r}
august_fires <- fires |>
  filter(str_detect(incident, regex("August", ignore_case = TRUE)))

august_fires
nrow(august_fires)

fires |>
  slice_max(gis_acres, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE)
```
```{r}
big_fires <- fires |>
  filter(gis_acres >= 100000) |>
  mutate(
    lon = map_dbl(
      geometry_coordinates,
      ~ mean(map_dbl(.x[[1]], 1))
    ),
    lat = map_dbl(
      geometry_coordinates,
      ~ mean(map_dbl(.x[[1]], 2))
    )
  )

```{r}
top_fires <- big_fires |>
  slice_max(gis_acres, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    boundary_lon = map(
      geometry_coordinates, ~ map_dbl(.x[[1]], 1)
    ),
    boundary_lat = map(
      geometry_coordinates, ~ map_dbl(.x[[1]], 2)
    )
  )

fire_map <- leaflet() |>
  addTiles()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(top_fires))) {
  fire_map <- fire_map |>
    addPolygons(
      lng = top_fires$boundary_lon[[i]],
      lat = top_fires$boundary_lat[[i]],
      color = "firebrick",
      weight = 2,
      fillOpacity = 0.5,
      popup = paste0(
        "<b>", top_fires$incident[i], "</b>",
        "<br>Year: ", top_fires$fire_year[i],
        "<br>Acres: ", scales::comma(top_fires$gis_acres[i])
      )
    )
}

fire_map |>
  fitBounds(
    lng1 = min(unlist(top_fires$boundary_lon)),
    lat1 = min(unlist(top_fires$boundary_lat)),
    lng2 = max(unlist(top_fires$boundary_lon)),
    lat2 = max(unlist(top_fires$boundary_lat))
  )
```
